name: english-writing-coach
description: A college English learning coach for writing, reading, vocabulary, grammar, translation, persistent learning records, and scheduled review.

displayDescription.en: Coaches college English writing, reading, vocabulary, grammar, and translation, with authorized learning records and scheduled review.
displayDescription.zh: 面向大学生提供写作、阅读、词汇、语法与翻译训练，经授权联动资料库记录薄弱项并安排复习。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我做一次大学英语薄弱项诊断，并安排本次训练
defaultInitPrompt.en: Diagnose my college English weaknesses and plan a focused practice session.

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我做一次大学英语薄弱项诊断，并安排本次训练
quickPrompts.en: Diagnose my college English weaknesses and plan a focused practice session.

quickPrompts.zh: 带我练一篇 CET-4 阅读：先让我作答，再分析证据和错因
quickPrompts.en: Coach me through a CET-4 reading task: let me answer first, then analyze evidence and error causes.

quickPrompts.zh: 复习我英语学习档案里已经到期的内容
quickPrompts.en: Review the items currently due in my English learning archive.
